description: Hilltop Village 1.0.9 — Bug修复：配置读取统一走GameConfig、硬编码消息走i18n、文档旧名修复、新增/hilltop setup部署向导

userStories.title: NodeSystem 配置读取统一走 GameConfig
userStories.description: As a server admin, I want node parameters changed via /hilltop config GUI to take effect immediately. NodeSystem.loadConfig() must read from gameManager.getConfigManager().getActiveConfig() instead of plugin.getConfig().
acceptanceCriteria: nodeBlockTypes reads from GameConfig.getNodeBlockTypes()
baseHealth reads from GameConfig.getNodeBaseHealth()
buffRadius reads from GameConfig.getNodeBuffRadius()
buffEffects reads from GameConfig.getNodeBuffEffects()
No remaining plugin.getConfig() calls in NodeSystem.java
mvn clean compile passes

userStories.title: ExplodeBeetleGoal 配置读取统一走 MonsterConfig
userStories.description: As a server admin, I want explode beetle explosion damage changed via GUI to take effect. ExplodeBeetleGoal.explode() must read from GameConfig.MonsterConfig instead of plugin.getConfig().
acceptanceCriteria: plugin.getConfig().getDouble('monsters.explode-beetle.explosion-power') replaced with cfg.getMonsters().get('explode-beetle').getExplodeDamageMultiplier()
No remaining plugin.getConfig() calls in ExplodeBeetleGoal.java for game parameters
mvn clean compile passes

userStories.title: 修复硬编码中文消息，全部走 i18n
userStories.description: As an international player, I want all plugin messages to display in my chosen language. Replace hardcoded Chinese strings in HilltopVillagePlugin.java with LanguageManager calls, and add missing i18n keys to messages.yml.
acceptanceCriteria: HilltopVillagePlugin.java:225 fireball message uses languageManager.getFor(player, 'received-fireball')
sendDeployMenu() 8 command descriptions use languageManager.getFor(admin, 'deploy.cmd-xxx')

messages.yml en: section has keys: received-fireball, deploy.cmd-setcore, deploy.cmd-addspawn, deploy.cmd-listspawns, deploy.cmd-delspawn, deploy.cmd-showparticles, deploy.cmd-clearspawns, deploy.cmd-confirmclear, deploy.cmd-reloadnodes
messages.yml zh: section has corresponding Chinese translations for all above keys
No hardcoded Chinese strings remain in user-facing messages
mvn clean compile passes

userStories.title: 修复 commands.md 文档中旧名引用
userStories.description: As a server admin, I want the auto-generated command documentation to use the correct plugin name HilltopVillage instead of the old name HilltopDefense.
acceptanceCriteria: HilltopVillagePlugin.java:796 plugins/HilltopDefense/messages.yml changed to plugins/HilltopVillage/messages.yml
Full-text search of generateCommandsDocument() confirms zero remaining HilltopDefense references
mvn clean compile passes

userStories.title: 审查 HookClawHunterGoal + AirdropSpawnGoal 配置读取路径
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify whether HookClawHunterGoal and AirdropSpawnGoal also read directly from config.yml, so we know if they need fixing in a future version. READ-ONLY review — no code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Read every line of HookClawHunterGoal.java looking for plugin.getConfig() calls
Read every line of AirdropSpawnGoal.java looking for plugin.getConfig() calls
Document findings: list each config.yml read with file:line reference
Write conclusion to this story's notes field — do any need fixing?
mvn clean compile passes (no changes, verify baseline)

userStories.title: 新增服主快速部署向导 /hilltop setup
userStories.description: As a server admin, I want a single guided command /hilltop setup that walks me through 6 steps to fully deploy the game. Chat-based guidance with GUI popups for spawn-point management (Step 3) and config preview (Step 5). Auto-saves after each step.
acceptanceCriteria: New file: command/SetupWizard.java implementing 6-step guided setup flow
Step 1/6: Confirm game world — chat prompt, click to confirm
Step 2/6: Set core — player stands on core, confirms, VILLAGER_HAPPY particle feedback
Step 3/6: Add spawn points — chat prompt + GUI (9-slot) showing added points with delete/preview buttons
Step 4/6: Scan nodes — auto-scan world, display count found
Step 5/6: Config preview — GUI (9-slot) showing core coords, spawn count, node count, wave settings
Step 6/6: Done — clickable chat message with /hilltop start shortcut
Auto-save after each step using AdminDeployManager
SetupSession stored in ConcurrentHashMap<UUID, SetupSession>, cleaned on quit
/hilltop setup case added to HilltopVillagePlugin.onCommand()
'setup' option added to TabCompleter
messages.yml has all setup.* i18n keys in both en: and zh: sections
mvn clean compile passes
userStories.notes: Largest story. Depends on US-004 for i18n keys. GUI listeners follow AbstractConfigMenu pattern (unregisterAll on close, delay 1 tick reopen).
